subject: English
title: Honk, Honk..., Toot, Toot
subtitle: The bus and the car on the road
hero_picture: A big blue bus with a friendly face and a small red car with a friendly face on a winding hill road, a police officer and animals by the road.

sections.heading: A bus and a car
text: This is a bus. A blue bus. The bus is big.
This is a car. A red car. The car is small.
Honk, honk bus! Toot, toot car!
sections.caption: A bus and a car
sections.picture: A big blue bus and a small red car with cartoon faces on a hill road.

sections.heading: Horn and lights
text: The bus has a horn. It sounds 'Honk, honk.'
The car has two lights. They are white.
Both run fast on the road.
sections.caption: Horn and lights
sections.picture: A close view of a blue bus with a horn and a red car with two white headlights.

sections.heading: Stop!
text: The bus does not stop. The car does not stop.
CRASH! The bus and the car hit each other.
sections.caption: Stop!
sections.picture: A blue bus and a red car bumping into each other on a road, a police officer raising his hand, animals running away.

sections.heading: It is your mistake
text: The horn fell down. The car's light fell down.
'It is your mistake.' 'No, it is your mistake.'
sections.caption: It is your mistake
sections.picture: A sad blue bus and a sad red car in front of a police officer, a horn and a headlight on the ground.

sections.heading: Do not repeat it
text: A monkey and a cow help. 'Here is your horn. Here is your light.'
The bus and the car are happy.
sections.caption: Do not repeat it
sections.picture: A monkey giving a horn back to the blue bus and a cow giving a light to the red car, a police officer smiling.

activity: Draw a bus or a car. Name its parts: wheels, lights, horn, windows.
talk: Why did the bus and the car crash?
What did the police officer say at the end?
summary: The bus and the car did not stop and crashed; they said sorry and learned to drive safely.

questions.prompt: What sound does the bus make?
